name: Martin Luther King, Jr.
hook: The minister, the March, and the martyr: the facts Jeopardy returns to again and again.

facts.label: Atlanta and Ebenezer Baptist Church
facts.statement: Martin Luther King Jr. was born in Atlanta in 1929 and served as co-pastor with his father at Ebenezer Baptist Church.

facts.label: the Montgomery bus boycott
facts.statement: King first gained prominence leading the 1955 Montgomery bus boycott against Alabama's segregated bus system.

facts.label: the Southern Christian Leadership Conference
facts.statement: He helped found the Southern Christian Leadership Conference in 1957 and led it until his death.

facts.label: Letter from Birmingham Jail
facts.statement: King's 1963 "Letter from Birmingham Jail" became a landmark document of the civil rights movement.

facts.label: the March on Washington
facts.statement: He delivered his "I Have a Dream" speech at the 1963 March on Washington.

facts.label: the Nobel Peace Prize
facts.statement: Martin Luther King Jr. won the Nobel Peace Prize in 1964.

facts.label: James Earl Ray
facts.statement: King was assassinated in Memphis in April 1968; James Earl Ray was convicted of the murder.
